boundary: The no-go is exact. Fourier eigenvalue multiplicities of the arithmetic factor are additionally checked numerically from the explicit orbit-sum matrix.
no_go: Different traces of Fourier-square (3 versus 1) are unitary-conjugacy invariants, so the reduced C35/C6 Fourier sector is not unitarily equivalent to F3 tensor F3.
